name: Shipdock
summary: Shopify pickup points, multi-carrier label printing and cash-on-delivery tracking, strongest on the Central European carrier networks. Listed in the Shopify App Store as "ShipD Labels & Pickup points" (apps.shopify.com/packeta) - same app by happyapps.cz, Shipdock is the earlier name (checked 18 September 2026).
best_for: Shopify merchants shipping in Central and Eastern Europe who want pickup points, multi-carrier label printing and cash-on-delivery tracking in one app rather than one integration per carrier, and who are on Shopify Plus, where the pickup-point picker sits inside checkout instead of after it
skip_if: your carriers are not in its list, which is the first thing to check, since the app's centre of gravity is Packeta and the Central European networks; or you need a label only occasionally, when a CSV export and your carrier's portal cost nothing
honest_knock:
Read the carrier list against your own country before anything else. The listing slug is 'packeta', the developer is happyapps.cz, and cash-on-delivery tracking is a headline feature: all three point at Central and Eastern Europe, where Packeta and Zásilkovna are everyday carriers and COD is a normal way to pay. More than twenty carriers are supported, but a US or UK merchant should confirm theirs is among them before the five-day trial starts.

The second thing is the trial length against the job. Five days on Lite and Basic is short for a shipping integration, because the test that matters is a real order going out with a real label to a real address. Install it on a day you are actually shipping, not on a quiet Sunday.

Third, the listing and the app disagree on the plans. On 17 November 2026 the listing showed Lite, Basic and Shopify Plus, while the app, in our own test session on 17 November 2026, showed Lite and Full and no Plus plan, with a free starting state that could not create a provider or a label.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes:
(read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/packeta, where the app is titled ShipD Labels & Pickup points, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026) On the listing Lite is $9.99 a month ($107.88 a year), Basic $14.99 ($161.89) and Shopify Plus $24.99 ($269.89). Every amount is unchanged since 22 August 2026. The listing has no free plan, and the entry tier still names its own limitation. Lite is labelled 'only CSV': pickup point and home delivery, an email reminder, the pickup-point widget on the thank-you and order-status pages, unlimited carriers across more than twenty, and an order export to custom CSV. Basic is the first tier that prints shipping labels, adding parcels created automatically after fulfilment and cash-on-delivery payment tracking. Shopify Plus moves the pickup-point widget into the checkout itself rather than the pages after it. Annual billing saves a stated 10% on each. Trials are five days on Lite and Basic and ten on Plus. Charges are in USD and recur every 30 days. The listing now names its carriers rather than counting them: Packeta, Balíkovna, DPD, Magyar Posta, InPost, DHL24, Posti, GLS and myGLS, Omniva, Foxpost, PPL, One, Telli, Eserviss, Esiunt, Slovenská pošta, Česká pošta, Fan Courier, Easyship, Econt and PostNord. Developer happyapps.cz; the app sits in Shopify's delivery and pickup category, is offered in English and Czech, and on 17 November 2026 carried 47 reviews, every one at five stars; in August there were 42, one of them at four.

The app itself showed a different ladder in our own test session on 17 November 2026, on a Shopify development store where the admin calls it ShipD Delivery. Its billing page showed two plans, not three: Lite at $9.99 a month (pickup point widget, export of orders to CSV, email support) and Full at $14.99 a month (adding shipping labels and cash on delivery payments through the carrier API), each with a 5 day trial, or $8.99 and $13.49 a month billed annually. It showed no Shopify Plus plan, and the label tier is called Full in the app where the listing calls it Basic. The current plan read Free ($0), but creating a provider and creating labels were both locked behind a paid plan. Twelve months at those yearly rates come to $107.88 and $161.88, within a cent of the listing's annual prices.
